# Defect Management Skill

Record reproducible defects with unique ID, severity, priority, affected requirement, environment/build, preconditions, steps, expected/actual result, evidence, impact, workaround, suspected cause, owner, fix version and regression test. Triage security/data-loss/publishing duplicates as highest urgency. Retest on the fixed build and run impacted regression tests before closure. Distinguish defect, requirement gap, change request and environment issue.
